scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Geometric single-step Cartier rank and Jacobian a-number for all algebraically closed characteristic-p fields, primes p>=5, and every coefficient a in the field
scientific_integrity.novelty_limits: The characteristic-three special case is already in Zhou (2019). Mathematical priority for higher primes is based on inspected available literature and is not an independent claim of exhaustive priority.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Riemann-Hurwitz and a full holomorphic monomial basis; explicit Cartier expansion; block ranks via polynomial interpolation over the prime field; exact finite block sum
scientific_limitations: No higher Cartier-rank or full Ekedahl-Oort calculation
No Newton polygon or Frobenius polynomial

title: Constant non-Hermitian \(a\)-number in a large-automorphism Artin–Schreier family
